summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing routine daily ASX reporting on its existing stock repurchase program, under which it is authorized to acquire up to $1 billion in aggregate of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock from time to time. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 reproduce the information furnished to the Australian Securities Exchange on the noted dates. No new authorization, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is ordinary buyback disclosure rather than a special situation; watch only cumulative repurchase pace and remaining authorization capacity.
